findings.body:
The post-change src/lib.rs has `pub fn add` opened on line 1 closed by a single `}` on line 3 followed by an extra `}` (line 3 is `}}`), leaving an unmatched closing brace at file scope. Rust rejects an unmatched `}` at top level, so compilation fails.

Trigger: Any compile of the crate (cargo build/test) after this change.

Impact: The crate does not compile, breaking the build for every consumer and CI run.
findings.suggestion: Replace `}}` on line 3 with a single `}`.
findings.title: Stray extra closing brace in src/lib.rs breaks compilation

risk_level.reason: Single-file change to a trivial add function; the diff appears to introduce a stray closing brace, which would likely break compilation rather than cause a subtle runtime defect.
